seo.title: sicorder — Record just part of a web page as video
seo.description: sicorder is a Chrome extension for web developers and marketers: pick an element, press Record, and get an MP4 of exactly that part of the page. No full-screen capture, no cropping, no trimming.

hero.title: Record just the part of the web page you need
hero.subtitle: Pick an element, press Record, and get an MP4 of exactly that element. No full-screen capture, no cropping, no trimming.
hero.ctaSoon: Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store
hero.note: Free · Runs entirely in your browser

problem.title: Stop recording your whole screen just to show one part of it
problem.text: When you need a clip of one component, an animated chart, a form flow or a new feature, the usual routine is to record the full screen, crop it in a video editor, trim the dead time and export again. sicorder skips all of that: the video contains exactly the part you picked, and nothing else.

pick.title: Pick a region
pick.text: Click the sicorder icon, turn on Pick Region and click the element you want. It highlights as you hover, like the element picker in DevTools, and a dotted border marks your choice.

record.title: Record
record.text: Press Record and use the page as usual. Only the picked element ends up in the video.

stop.title: Stop
stop.text: Press Stop. The MP4 lands in your Downloads folder.

exact.title: Exactly the element, no cropping
exact.text: The video matches the element's bounds pixel for pixel, at your display's full resolution.

smart.title: No dead time to trim
smart.text: With Smart recording on, sicorder stops adding frames after half a second without any visual change and picks up again when something moves.

pause.title: Pauses when you look away
pause.text: Scroll the element out of view or switch tabs and recording pauses, so the gap never shows up in the video.

autoStop.title: Stops on its own
autoStop.text: If the element disappears or the page navigates away, sicorder stops, saves what it recorded and tells you why.

names.title: Files you can find later
names.text: Recordings are named after the site, the element and the date, like github_pull_request_2026_09_14.mp4.

share.title: Ready to share
share.text: MP4 (H.264) plays in Slack, docs, pull requests, email and every video player.

developers.title: Web developers
developers.text: Attach a clip of a bug or a finished feature to a pull request or issue, without anything else on your screen in the frame.

designers.title: Designers and product managers
designers.text: Capture a single component or interaction for a spec, a review or a changelog.

marketers.title: Marketers
marketers.text: Record clean product clips for landing pages, social posts and launch announcements, cropped to the part of the app that matters.

support.title: Support and documentation teams
support.text: Show one widget or one step without the rest of the interface.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Recording and encoding happen entirely in your browser, and videos go straight to your Downloads folder. sicorder never uploads your recordings and never sends page content, URLs or file names. It sends anonymous usage statistics, such as how many recordings are started and saved, so we can improve it. No account needed.

items.pages: Works on regular web pages (http and https). Chrome doesn't allow extensions to record its own pages, such as chrome:// settings or the Web Store.
items.pointer: The mouse pointer appears in the recording when it's over the picked element.

contact.title: Questions or feedback?
contact.subtitle: We'd love to hear how you use sicorder.

footer.description: sicorder records just the part of a web page you pick, as an MP4.
